news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported Q2 2026 non-cash royalty revenue of about $10.1 million and a net loss of roughly $40.6 million, beating consensus EPS estimates, while ending the quarter with $1.02 billion in cash and investments and no debt. Management reiterated that the cash position, bolstered by an April 2026 $350 million offering, funds operations into Q3 2028, past the first Phase 3 ZENITH AD data readouts expected mid-2028.

news.headline: Nektar finalizes registrational Phase 3 plans in alopecia areata after positive FDA End-of-Phase 2 meeting
news.summary: Alongside Q2 results, Nektar said it finalized plans for a single registrational Phase 3 trial of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata following its Q2 2026 FDA End-of-Phase 2 meeting, targeting a trial start in early 2027. This builds on positive 52-week extension data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA study reported earlier in 2026.

news.headline: Nektar beats Q2 2026 EPS but stock slips after hours
news.summary: Despite an earnings-per-share beat, NKTR shares slipped in after-hours trading following the August 13 report, as investors weighed rising R&D spend (up to $39.1 million from $29.9 million a year earlier) tied to ZENITH AD startup costs and manufacturing scale-up.

news.headline: Walleye Capital LLC takes new stake in Nektar Therapeutics as institutional buying builds
news.summary: Walleye Capital disclosed a new position in NKTR, part of a broader wave of institutional accumulation in Q2 2026 that included BlackRock more than quadrupling its stake (+324.7%, ~$157 million) and State Street nearly quadrupling its holding (+271.7%).

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity initiates Nektar Therapeutics at Buy with $153 price target
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity analyst Edward Nash began coverage of Nektar with a Buy rating and $153 price target, citing the clinical progress of rezpegaldesleukin's Phase 3 program in atopic dermatitis.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, the first two of three global, placebo-controlled Phase 3 trials of rezpegaldesleukin in patients aged 12 and up with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with a third trial (ZENITH AD-3) planned for biologic/JAK-experienced patients. The company guided to topline data in mid-2028 and a first BLA filing in 2029.

catalysts.label: Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury trial
catalysts.detail: Rescheduled jury trial (originally set for October 2025, delayed by the federal government shutdown) in Nektar's breach-of-contract and data-manipulation lawsuit against former rezpegaldesleukin partner Eli Lilly, in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California; outcome could affect damages/IP posture around REZPEG's early trial history.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 ZENITH AD topline data
catalysts.detail: First topline readouts expected from the ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2 pivotal trials of rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, per company guidance reiterated at Q2 2026 earnings.

catalysts.label: First BLA submission (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance for Nektar's first regulatory filing for rezpegaldesleukin, contingent on positive Phase 3 ZENITH AD data.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata trial start
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to initiate a single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata following its positive FDA End-of-Phase 2 meeting.

catalysts.label: Vitiligo first-in-human study start
catalysts.detail: Nektar has guided to initiating its first clinical study of rezpegaldesleukin in vitiligo during 2026; a specific start date has not yet been disclosed.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and pipeline update
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly financial results and conference call, expected based on Nektar's historical reporting cadence; will likely include ZENITH AD enrollment progress and updated cash runway.

pulse: Nektar has fully repositioned around rezpegaldesleukin (REZPEG), its Treg-stimulating biologic for atopic dermatitis, alopecia areata and other autoimmune indications, after regaining full rights from former partner Eli Lilly, with litigation over the earlier partnership's trial-data dispute still pending (jury trial rescheduled to September 8, 2026). The company started its pivotal Phase 3 ZENITH AD program in July 2026 and, backed by roughly $1.02 billion in cash following an April 2026 offering, guided to Phase 3 topline data in mid-2028 and a first BLA filing in 2029, with a parallel Phase 3 alopecia areata trial planned for early 2027. Sell-side sentiment has turned bullish (Strong Buy consensus, average price target near $153 after Canaccord's late-July initiation) and institutional buying has picked up, though shares dipped after the August 13 Q2 print despite an EPS beat, as investors weighed rising R&D spend needed to fund the expanded pipeline.
